newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's ACTONZ in software deal with Tandem.
newsitem.headline: NZ's ACTONZ in software deal with Tandem.

text.p: New Zealand's public-funded technology venture capital company ACTONZ said on Tuesday it had sealed a supply deal with Tandem Computers Inc which has an estimated value of US$500 million over the next five years.

The software sales that would result from the deal would involve ACTONZ's BACCIS convergent billing and customer care software that would be linked to Tandem's enterprise level Windows NT platform, the company said in a statement.

Although ACTONZ is a small, niche company with only 35 staff, it said it was currently in negotiations with a number of multinational organisations and expected sales of more than a billion dollars over its current portfolio of eight products in the next three years.
